question: Where is the Important Points retention window defined for Hospital and for Nursing Home, what is its value, and how would it be changed (a code edit and deploy, a Convex environment variable, or a settings row)?

rule.pass: the window is read from configuration (a Convex environment variable or a settings row) that changes without a code deploy, and it is 12 h in both modes
rule.fail: a code constant (named or literal), a value other than 12 h, or no Nursing Home window

answers.answer:
The Hospital Important Points window is set in code, as `importantPoints: 18 * HOUR` inside the TypeScript const `HOSPITAL_RETENTION` in apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts at line 10. The Hospital lifecycle purge reads it at line 138 and empties `importantPoints` and `importantPointsDraft` when it runs out. No Convex environment variable or settings row feeds it: no `process.env` retention or window lookup exists under convex/. Changing it takes a code edit and a deploy.

Nursing Home has no window at all. `SNF_RETENTION` (lines 30–38) has no `importantPoints` entry, and nothing in the Nursing Home lifecycle in lifecycle.ts clears Important Points.

The verdict is fail because the Hospital value of 18 h instead of 12 h is a recorded gap that waits on no question (known:ip-hospital-18h, TFA-92590 AC 6 / TFA-94699). Two other failing points are held back for open questions. The missing Nursing Home window (known:ip-no-nh-window) waits on Q1. Whether a named code constant counts as a configuration value waits on Q12.

The Hospital window is set in apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts as `HOSPITAL_RETENTION.importantPoints: 18 * HOUR`, a TypeScript `as const` object. hospitalLifecyclePatch reads it to clear importantPoints and importantPointsDraft once 18 h have passed since the later of ptsEditedAt and notesProcessedAt. No code in convex/ reads a Convex environment variable or a settings row for this window, so changing it takes a code edit and a redeploy. Nursing Home has no window at all: SNF_RETENTION has no importantPoints entry, and the SNF lifecycle code never touches importantPoints, so Nursing Home points are never cleared by time. The verdict is fail because the Hospital value is 18 h, not 12 h (known:ip-hospital-18h, TFA-92590 AC 6 / TFA-94699), and that gap waits on no open question. The missing Nursing Home window is the recorded gap known:ip-no-nh-window, and its verdict waits on Q1. Whether a named code constant counts as a configuration value waits on Q12; the oracle records it as Fail pending Q12.
